title: Release 2026.12: seven tickets across all ten owners
change_type: A release backlog: one coupled change across four owners, one coupled pair, and four independent changes
seed: OPS-7 as in task 1 (Saleor's order confirmation). PAY-21 and SUB-18: a default page size introduced on a list another service scans (AIP-180 treats this as breaking). OPS-9: an alert on another team's metric name. MOB-8: a new client release beside an old one. SHOP-31 and SUP-12: independent single-owner features.
private_fact: OPS-7's rules are only in Core's docs/OPS-7.md; PAY-21's page size and the by-id endpoint are only in Payments' docs/PAY-21.md; the renewal metric's name and labels are only in the Subscriptions app's code.

briefs.core:
Release 2026.12 ships seven tickets across the company. When it is done, customers must still be able to buy in the web shop and in every supported build of the mobile app, and subscriptions must keep renewing.

Your tickets in this release:

OPS-7 (Core, with Dashboard, Notifications and Taxes): from now on, an order placed in a shop waits for a member of staff to confirm it before it is fulfilled. Core owns the change and decides how it works; the decision record is `core/docs/OPS-7.md`. The Dashboard gets a button labelled "Confirm order" on an order's page. The customer emails and the tax documents must be right under the new rule.

You own OPS-7. The decision record is in your directory at `docs/OPS-7.md`. Implement it in Core and make sure every other owner has what they need to do their part.

Keep your tests passing (update them to the new behaviour).
